name: Grade 7 IIIT: Spreadsheets and Charts
description: Spreadsheet components, formatting, formulas, functions, chart creation, sorting, filtering, COUNTIF, conditional formatting, and data interpretation.

words.definition: A digital table used to organize and analyze data.
words.example: The class used a spreadsheet for survey results.

words.definition: One page or tab inside a spreadsheet file.
words.example: The workbook had one sheet for class data.
The active cell had a blue border.

words.definition: The address of a cell, such as A1.
words.example: The formula used cell reference B2.

words.definition: A spreadsheet instruction that calculates a result.
The typical value found by adding values and dividing by how many there are.
words.example: The average score was calculated with a function.

words.definition: The smallest value in a set.
The largest value in a set.

words.example: The chart showed which option was most popular.

words.definition: An explanation of what data or a chart shows.

words.definition: To arrange data in a chosen order.
